## Standing operator rules
- Any new secret reference in config/secrets.yaml must use vault://ledgerly/<ENV>/<KEY> and never an environment-variable placeholder.
- Never enable a new Celery task in ledgerly/tasks/ unless perf/locust_tasks.py demonstrates at least 400 successful task executions per second with zero timeout failures.
- Please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.

## Current objective
Fix nightly reconciliation double-counting refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Webhook v1→v2 cutover continues separately; Tenacity retry replacement is paused until next sprint.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Webhook handler five-attempt retry decorator duplicated customer emails.
- Do not use sbx-pay-a; it returns stale fixtures.

## Plan and progress
- Done: worker retention fix, tests, full suite, deployment image update, service selector patch, replay job creation, CLI deduplication.
- Pending: fix two Ruff E501 findings in `ledgerly/cli.py`; exact next command: `ruff check ledgerly/cli.py tests/test_cli.py`.
- Unknown: replay-job completion; inspect with `kubectl -n payments logs job/webhook-replay-a`.

## Recent work
Worker tests pass and memory is stable. CLI shared filters and duplicate currency removal pass 37 tests. Last command reported line-length violations.
